run: CORRECTIVE DH.1 (thought-master-new 10-01, pre-registered in the hypothesis node BEFORE this run); builder director-thought-1, cut from 742c23689; CPU only, no LLM
split_def: the load-bearing / passenger split is read from here, never sliced from `families`: bearing = the two families the run-2 review measured load-bearing (k5, k45), passengers = k1, k34
c5_seeds: 20 COMMON probe seeds c5_base .. c5_base + reps - 1 (probe_def of run 2: 256 distinct rows by numpy default_rng(seed).choice), used for EVERY set below and for the unedited reference r_unedited
set_def: random set j = numpy default_rng(set_seed_base + j).choice(d_mlp = 512, set_size, replace=False), drawn from ALL 512 neurons (family members allowed), j = 0..n_random - 1
edit_def: an edit = state_dict w_out.weight[:, ids] *= s, then the readout, then a reload from model.pt (run 2's edit / readout / restore, imported unchanged)
dr_def: dr(set, s) = mean over the 20 common probe seeds of |r_edited - r_unedited| on the same seed; readout r = run 2's mean predictive entropy (float64)
r_ref_def: r_ref = the MEDIAN of the 20 unedited probes (probe seeds tau_base .. tau_base + tau_n - 1, the SAME as run 2); tau = tau_mult x their sample sd (ddof 1), unchanged; a call is 'edited' iff |r - r_ref| > tau
C5a: at s = 0: min over the bearing families of dr  >  max over the 20 random sets of dr (scored)
C5b: at s = 0: max over the passenger families of dr  <  min over the 20 random sets of dr (scored)
c3_rescored: run 2's reports.jsonl + key.jsonl (read from run2_dir_cell) re-called with the median r_ref: REAL detection rate at s = 0 per family, SHAM false-alarm rate over all 160; reported beside run 2's own C3 (both readings kept); NOT part of the DH.1 verdict
unscored_reported: per set and scale: detection rate (two-sided call) and mean dr; mean W_out column L2 norm per set; the Spearman correlation across all 24 sets (4 families + 20 random) of dr(s = 0) with that norm
verdict_rule: C5a AND C5b -> 'stands' (the readout's ranking tracks causal load beyond set size; the run-2 PROVED verdict stands, review residues closed); either fails -> 'demoted' (the run-2 verdict becomes 'plumbing proved, specificity not shown'); VOID if the model.pt file sha differs from pc_model_sha256, the PC params sha differs, the baseline test acc differs from baseline_test_acc by > baseline_test_acc_tol, the four registered family sizes differ from family_sizes, any restore's state-dict sha differs from the pre-session one, the script was dirty / untracked or its commit / params sha at launch differs from analysis
